description: META tool: Inputs Generation Technology, Projected Costs is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Extractive industries", published or maintained by World Bank Group. This dataset contains the input parameters for Model for Electricity Technology Assessment (META) tool for US, Romania, Jamaica and India (base year 2010). Furthermore, the META projected costs for 2015 and 2020 are presented. Coverage: India, Jamaica, Romania and the United States. It has 1 file in CSV. The portal files it under Extractive industries. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
